Kit summary

Mech SmashBasic
Deals 480% ATK DMG to a single enemy. If the target is under Control status, increases the DMG to 680% and ignores 30% of the target's DEF.
Berserk StrikeActive
Deals 1000% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn and a 100% chance to remove 1 layer of buffs from them. When the target's buffs are removed successfully, absorbs 20% of their current Turn Meter and inflicts [Severe Wound] on them for 3 turns.
Mech PulsePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
When an ally with the [Control] and [Direct DMG] tag deals DMG, grants all allies 1 layer of [Mech Force Field], each of which increases Skill DMG by 1%, up to 50 layers. Meanwhile, additionally deals Direct DMG by 150% of Pelor's ATK to the target once.
Blue Core Pulse Lv.1Allies gain 1 extra layer of [Mech Force Field] each time they gain [Mech Force Field] through Mech Pulse. At the beginning of each wave, for every 1 ally with the [Control] tag deployed, increases all allies' Effect RES by 50% and reduces all enemies' Effect RES by 30% for 1 turn.
Blue Core Pulse Lv.2When a battle starts, all allies with the [Control] or [Direct DMG] tag gain 40 layers of [Mech Force Field] and are immune to the first Control effect received. At the end of Pelor's turns, restores all allies' HP equal to 20% of Pelor's Max HP.
Blue Core Pulse Lv.3Increases the extra DMG dealt by Mech Pulse by 100%. At the end of Pelor's turns, increases all allies' Effect RES by 20% and reduces Skill DMG taken by 10% for 1 turn.
Dauntless ChargeActive
Deals 490% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 100% chance to inflict [Stun] on the targets for 1 turn. Meanwhile, inflicts [DEF Down II] for 2 turns. Grants all allies [ATK Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns.
